title: World Bloom — To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage — Episode5 A Flittering Guest

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage
meta.Event Outline: On MORE MORE JUMP!'s first free day in quite some time, they have been enjoying school life to the full. Their recent TV appearance has caused a buzz among their classmates, renewing their determination to keep working their hardest. That's when they each find themselves in an unfamiliar part of SEKAI...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is this place...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Isn't this crazy?
You should've seen the way KAITO reacted. He nearly fell into that pond over there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sh-She doesn't need to know that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, what made this place appear all of a sudden? The path we took to get here is also something I'd never seen until now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't know, but I suspect that something about what you and the others are feeling must've changed, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm inclined to agree.
After all, this SEKAI was born out of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, our feelings...? What's changed...?
We've been very busy lately, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? A butterfly...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Look at that.
Its bright orange wings are so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And delicate. Like the hem of a floaty dress. Which species do you think it is?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Its wings really are beautiful...
They're bright, shiny and...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oddly captivating.
I'm feeling all this nostalgia for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, it landed on that flower...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Huh?
There's a vine wrapped around that flower...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
Also, it looks kind of strange.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And this glistening bit. Is it the nectar?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, this butterfly was just trying to get to the nectar?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I feel bad about it being caught in a vine like this, so I think I'll try to free it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, Haruka, be careful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's very slippery around the pond, so please watch your step.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll be careful, but this is wrapped around it much more tightly than I...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh...?
This light...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Children's Voices
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to perform for us today!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That sounded like a group of children...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wh-Where am I...?
Thank you for listening to my song!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line: Seeing all your beautiful smiles has filled me with so much joy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's her...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I really love the way you sing!

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line:
You're done already?
Can you come back again next Sunday?

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Yeah, we wanna sing with you more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you all very much!
Unfortunately, this is it for today.

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line:
But I'm sure we'll meet again someday.
When we do, let's sing lots and lots more together!

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line: So, let's pinky swear!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I didn't realize she performed in places like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have no idea if this actually happened or if this is all part of my imagination...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But it's nice to see that she's still making people smile...)

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line: Alright, next, it's time for that fun anime to air! Let's see... It's on channel...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Is something wrong?
She's parked herself in front of that TV for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Show MC
rows.Line: <And our second most watched show from this past week is... “Chat A Lot About Nothing with Takashi Arimura!”>

rows.Speaker: Show MC
rows.Line: <And we have the “Check Out All The Cool Stuff In The Station's Gift Shop!” segment coming in as the most watched part of the program! Check out our highlight reel!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Oh wow! Look at these!
They're shaped like the studio's mascot, Mr. Alarm!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Chocolate inside a monaka wedged into a cookie wrapped in a waffle... Mr. Alarm has become a snack within a snack!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This program...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <But these kinds of souvenirs are meant to be passed out to a lot of people, so I think it's good that they have a wide variety available.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<I agree.
Also because these are all really good.>

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line:
<You've eaten them already, Haruka?!
The rest of us haven't even opened them yet!>

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line:
Haruka's still doing her best as an idol...
That's so great to see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line: I was so worried when she left ASRUN, so I'm relieved to see that she's decided to go back to being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line: Hehe. I knew she had talent...

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line: And I know that tomorrow's going to be a better day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...!
Where am I n...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wh-What was that light...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That was startling.
It became so bright all of a sudden and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you okay, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm okay...
But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you two also see...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See what?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
I guess I'm the only one who saw.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Are you sure you're okay...?
Maybe that light did something to your eyes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, no, my eyes are fine.
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You saw your hero watching the show you were on the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I did...
It may've just been a pleasant dream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But it made me really happy.
She even said how inspired she was after seeing me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was able to spread hope to wherever she was through the airwaves...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In that sense...
I'm really glad I decided to keep trying.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't think it was just a pleasant dream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree...
I think the person you saw really was her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, you've been working all this time to take the hope she instilled in you and spread it to so many others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I wouldn't be surprised if you were able to give back some of that hope to her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You might be right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But... That still isn't enough.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Ever since that day she inspired me, I've been striving to be like her. I still am even now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(And yet...
I still don't feel like I've been able to reach where she was when we first met. I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(She hasn't stopped.
She's still spreading hope to everybody she can.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's still inspiring them, making them smile and...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's it...
That's what's most important.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I found the answer to my question.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, about coming up with a plan to make your dream come true?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's still a lot that we have to consider, but as long as spreading hope to others remains our top priority...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We should be able to carve out a path and find the right answers in terms of what we need to do to make our ultimate dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I actually feel a little relieved now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. All of you will most likely encounter some tough tasks and difficult challenges in the future...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll do fine since you're driven by such powerful feelings. I doubt that's going to change.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. And we'll keep giving you all the support we can so that you'll also be able to spread hope to those who don't know who you are yet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, it's flying away.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You managed to free this flower from that vine, Haruka, but I guess our fluttery friend wasn't after its nectar...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Wait a second... That butterfly's wings...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They resemble her outfit.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She did it again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I hope you're watching.
I'm going to take the hope you gave me and spread it to others as we make more and more progress towards making our dream come true.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our dream of one day doing a show at the Dome.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I really hope that I'll get to see your smiling face there...)

rows.Speaker: Movie
